empire.name: Crown Imperium
empire.blurb: Order bought with cruelty. The seawalls hold the Black Tide back, and the Crown never asks what they cost.

alliance.name: Free Confederacy
alliance.blurb: Freedom paid for in plunder. Every captain elected, every share counted on deck, and half the Moot worth hanging.

neutral.name: Unaligned Isles
neutral.blurb: Islands that have not picked a side, and would rather not.
